title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity - params, roles, stop/logprobs, streaming & formatting fixes
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: bring Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer for /v1/chat.completions fully up-to-par with expected params semantics (temperature/top_p/stop), role handling, stop/logprobs passthrough, streaming stability, and response formatting consistency (including tool/function calling markers). This PR unifies parameter parsing across the HTTP compat layer and the internal Chat API, fixes several streaming edge cases that caused truncated function call messages, and restores logprobs behavior for compat clients. Changes include: updated param normalization, stricter role validation and backward-compatible role coercion, stop sequence handling for batched/streamed responses, logprobs inclusion toggle and size guards, and multiple streaming buffer/flush fixes to avoid mid-token cuts. Checklist: - [x] Param mapping tests added - [x] Streaming e2e tests (simulated network jitter) - [x] Function/tool calling examples updated - [x] Docs + migration notes updated - [x] Performance regression check (no >5% p95 increase) Notes: this was driven by customer reports (SUP-1210) and internal compatibility test suites that flagged differences vs. OpenAI's observed behavior. See linked Linear tasks for rollout gating.
commits: feat(openai-compat): normalize chat params and map stop/logprobs flags
fix(streaming): prevent mid-token truncation by deferring flush during token assembly
chore(tests): add jittered streaming e2e harness and new compat vectors
fix(chat): stricter role validation with backward-compatible coercion for legacy clients
perf(runtime): small batching tweak to keep latency stable under new parsing path
docs: migration note for clients upgrading from legacy stop/logprobs behavior

release_notes: Compatibility: /v1/chat.completions - parameter normalization fixes (temperature, top_p, presence_penalty), role validation/coercion, stop sequence handling for streamed responses; restored logprobs passthrough with size guard; streaming stability fixes reducing mid-token truncation; docs and examples updated to show function/tool calling behavior.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for param normalization and role coercion, added streaming e2e harness that injects variable latency/jitter and verifies token boundaries and function call boundaries. Ran compatibility matrix against historical OpenAI vectors and internal regression suite. Manual QA: exercised TS/Python SDK examples and the compat example app.
notes_for_ops: Rollout: feature gated behind compat.v1.chat parity flag. Ops: watch metric compat.chat.streaming.truncated_tokens and compat.chat.logprobs.errors. If >0.1% rate, rollback gate and investigate stream_writer metrics.
